–
Papers: 2,212 ACM RecSys papers 2007–2025 (Semantic Scholar) and the 263 accepted for RecSys 2026 (recsys.acm.org). Regions: k-means over sentence embeddings of title and abstract, placed by similarity; names were assigned by hand from each region's keywords. Open problems and author questions are drafted by AI models from abstracts and not yet checked by people. Keyword trends match title, authors and abstract (abstracts available for about two thirds of the papers). Discussion: RecSys Atlas colab (sign in with GitHub). Paper details and recommendations: RecSys Atlas Explore (powered by Recombee). Initiated by Pavel Kordík (FIT CTU Prague & Recombee). CC BY 4.0.
